policy: No signal scores read. Pfam curated GA and >=70% model coverage (RVT_1/Domain_X >=60%, checked on full-length LtrA); competitive ISEScan >=20 domain-bit margin; complete dominant ORF; >=90% unique-member consistency with no conflicting supported label. group II requires same-strand downstream D5 plus RT/maturase on one ORF. These are conservative annotation policies, not measured classification accuracy.
limitations: No experimental mechanism inferred for individual bags
IS200 vs IS605 subtype not forced
RAYT exclusion based on sparse reviewed references; residual uncertainty possible
TnpB-like architecture is not an activity assay; Cas12/IscB homolog discrimination may require further references
Unrecognized, frameshifted or partial proteins stay unresolved
Source-event annotation does not validate actual carrier-copy sequence
